_comment: Template for the unisign_rgb_pose_slt model bundle manifest. Copy to <bundle-dir>/manifest.json and adjust the relative paths. All path fields resolve relative to the bundle directory (absolute paths also work). models/ is gitignored, so live bundles never enter the repository; this template is the committed reconstruction recipe. alignment_dir MUST be the npz directory (artifacts/.../pose) whose metadata_json carries alignment.best_start -- the JSON alignment directory is NOT supported and is rejected at load time. hand_conf_layout: 'legacy' (default) reproduces the frozen baseline verbatim -- the official pose pkl stores scores as (T,1,133) while upstream hand sampling indexes confs[:, 91:112], which yields empty selections, so the frozen 26.3026 BLEU ran with ZERO RGB support (a coincidence-level match to the paper's 26.36, not the paper protocol); 'squeeze' reshapes (T,1,133)->(T,133) so hand crops carry real frames (the corrected variant); 'auto' picks by shape. Keep 'legacy' for regression runs, 'squeeze' for corrected runs.
